question.text: Given EBIT(1-T) = 100, Depreciation = 20, CapEx = 30, and working-capital change = 10, FCFF equals:

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.47 gives FCFF = EBIT(1 - Tax Rate) + Depreciation - Capital Expenditure - Change in Working Capital. Substituting: FCFF = 100 + 20 - 30 - 10 = 80. The Trap: Sign errors on CapEx or working-capital change produce the other options. Note: Apply the p.47 formula exactly as written, subtracting both CapEx and the change in working capital.
